_note: Defaults of the llm-agent baseline strategy (reasoning/strategies/llm-agent/). It asks a model through TinyAgent (lib/tinyagent.mjs): `model` is a TinyAgent tier (small, good, ...), `<provider>/<model>`, or a model of the openference plan (default `Qwen3.8 27b`); `upstream` names the provider explicitly. The model is asked with its fallback off; there is no omp and no fallback model by default. Environment overrides: CHATSOP_LLM_AGENT_MODEL, CHATSOP_LLM_AGENT_PRESENTATION.
